[범주값 조건]

  예: 질의 "남성", 허용값 `8507=남성` ⇒ WHERE person.gender_concept_id = 8507

[개념 후보 선택]
- "개념 후보"는 표면어별로 여러 concept_id(영문명·도메인)가 온다. 표면어당 영문명이 가장 맞는 '앵커 1개'만 골라 그 [테이블.컬럼]에 조건을 건다(도메인이 곧 테이블). 수식어가 없으면 [상위개념] 태그가 붙은 더 일반적인 후보를 앵커로 고른다.

val_299.gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select de.person_id, min(de.drug_exposure_start_date) as index_date from drug_exposure de where de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1511251)) group by de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '24' MONTH AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '24' MONTH ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '24_MONTH_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

val_425.gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4066543)) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '17' YEAR AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '17' YEAR ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '17_YEAR_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

[concept_id·코드 생성 금지]

- 성별·방문유형·진단상태 등 범주 컬럼은 테이블 블록에서 컬럼 아래 `허용값: 코드=라벨` 로 주어진다. 질의의 범주 표현에 맞는 코드를 골라 `컬럼 = 코드`를 WHERE 에 쓴다.
  예: 질의 "남성", 허용값 `8507=남성` ⇒ WHERE person.gender_concept_id = 8507

[개념 후보 선택]
- "개념 후보"는 표면어별로 여러 concept_id(영문명·도메인)가 온다. 표면어당 영문명이 가장 맞는 '앵커 1개'만 골라 그 [테이블.컬럼]에 조건을 건다(도메인이 곧 테이블). 수식어가 없으면 [상위개념] 태그가 붙은 더 일반적인 후보를 앵커로 고른다.
- 후보 id 를 IN (id1, id2, …) 로 나열하지 않는다. 하위 개념 포함은 앵커 1개를 concept_ancestor 로 전개한다: IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 앵커).
- 맞는 후보가 하나도 없으면 억지로 고르지 말고 값 자리에 {{표면어}}로 남긴다(틀린 개념보다 미해결이 낫다 — 이후 재탐색, 그래도 없으면 실패).

- 날짜/기간은 "조건:"에 환산된 구체 날짜(YYYY-MM-DD)를 그대로 쓴다("최근 1년" 등 상대표현 직접 해석 금지). 양끝은 BETWEEN 시작 AND 종료, 한쪽만은 >= 시작 / <= 종료. datetime 아닌 대표 *_date 컬럼에 건다([형식: ...] 참고).
- CURRENT_DATE·NOW() 등 현재시각 함수 금지(데이터 시점과 어긋남). "오늘"이 필요하면 [재료]의 기준일 DATE 리터럴을 그대로 쓴다(예: DATE '2025-01-12'). 기준일은 컬럼이 아니다.

val_723.gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1242725)) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date THEN f.death_date ELSE f.observation_period_end_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date THEN 'DEATH' ELSE 'OBSERVATION_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

val_464.text: 골다공증 진단 이력이 있는 환자를 노출군으로 설정.
val_464.gold: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (80502)) );

val_719.gold: SELECT po.person_id, MIN(po.procedure_date) AS index_date FROM procedure_occurrence po WHERE po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4066543)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM procedure_occurrence prior_po WHERE prior_po.person_id = po.person_id AND prior_po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4066543)) AND prior_po.procedure_date < po.procedure_date ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = po.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4112853)) AND co.condition_start_date <= po.procedure_date ) GROUP BY po.person_id;

val_473.gold: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4203771)) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '5' YEAR AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '5' YEAR ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '5_YEAR_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

seed_35_test_restructure.text: 암로디핀 최초 처방일부터 사망일, 자료 관찰 종료일, 3년 도달일 중 가장 이른 날짜를 추적 종료일로 정의
seed_35_test_restructure.gold: SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, CASE WHEN d.death_date IS NOT NULL AND d.death_date <= op.observation_period_end_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '3' YEAR THEN d.death_date WHEN op.observation_period_end_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '3' YEAR THEN op.observation_period_end_date ELSE i.index_date + INTERVAL '3' YEAR END AS followup_end_date FROM (SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1332418)) GROUP BY de.person_id) AS i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date

seed_547_test_restructure.gold: SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date THEN f.death_date ELSE f.observation_period_end_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date THEN 'DEATH' ELSE 'OBSERVATION_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM (SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date FROM (SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (19005626)) GROUP BY de.person_id) i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date) f;
